description: The voice scope of Accessible first: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: voice.roles
answers.why: Hints and help text carry people through each step.

answers.question: voice.count
answers.why: One plain tone everywhere; no surprises.

answers.question: voice.definition
answers.why: A word list of common words, with terms to avoid.

answers.question: voice.values
answers.why: Every sentence is easy to read on the first try.

answers.question: voice.lands
answers.why: Words decide whether a form gets finished.

usage.use: A common verb that says what happens next
usage.why: Common words are understood by the most people.

usage.use: Say what is wrong, where, and exactly how to fix it
usage.why: People must be able to fix the error without help.
usage.example: Enter your date of birth. For example, 27 3 1980.

usage.use: Confirm what happened and what comes next
usage.not: A confirmation with no next step
usage.why: People need to know the task is finished and what happens now.
usage.example: We have your application. We will email you within 5 working days.

usage.use: Explain what will appear here and how to start
usage.why: A blank page leaves people unsure if something failed.
usage.example: You have no saved applications. Start a new one below.

usage.use: Say what will happen in plain words, and offer a way back
usage.why: Plain words prevent a choice people did not mean.
usage.example: Do you want to cancel your application? Your answers will be deleted.

usage.use: Say how many steps there are and how long it takes
usage.why: Knowing the length lowers effort and anxiety.
usage.example: This takes about 10 minutes. There are 4 steps.

content.$description: Voice tokens: the words components use for common actions. Text, not CSS.

commit.$description: The label of the action that completes a task.

cancel.$description: The label of the way out next to the main action.

destroy.$description: The label of an action that deletes data.

retry.$description: The label that repeats a failed action.

empty-action.$description: The label of the action in an empty state.
